dct_description_sm: Schedule “B” includes the roads illustrated by hierarchy. These include Major (City and Regional) Arterial, Minor Arterial, Collector Roads, Provincial Highways (current and proposed), and local roads (current and proposed). The map also indicates North-South Transportation Corridor and its Protection Area, as well as the Highway 427 Corridor Protection Area.
dct_title_s: Official Plan Schedule B City Road Hierarchy
